evidence.title: Forecasters fear a hurricane is brewing in the Gulf

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center 2026 Atlantic tropical cyclone database
occurrences.quote_span: If the storm did strengthen into a hurricane, it would be the first one of the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season (although eight tropical storms have formed).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center tropical cyclone intensity definitions
occurrences.quote_span: A tropical storm becomes a hurricane when its sustained winds reach 74 mph.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 Atlantic hurricane season storm-name list maintained by the World Meteorological Organization or National Hurricane Center
occurrences.quote_span: The next name on the list of names for 2026 is Isaias (pronounced ees-ah-EE-ahs).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: Alex DaSilva's AccuWeather forecast for the Gulf system
occurrences.quote_span: "We expect this mass of showers and thunderstorms to overcome wind shear and evolve into a tropical depression or storm," AccuWeather's DaSilva explained.
occurrences.speaker: Alex DaSilva
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center public advisory or forecast discussion for the Gulf system on October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: "It is still too early to determine specific impacts to the northern Gulf Coast, but interests from the Florida Panhandle to Louisiana should closely monitor the progress of this system," the hurricane center warned.
occurrences.speaker: National Hurricane Center
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Weather Service rainfall and flood observations and forecasts for the northern Gulf Coast, southeastern United States and Florida
occurrences.quote_span: And regardless of development, heavy rainfall and associated flooding impacts could occur over portions of the northern Gulf Coast, the southeastern United States and Florida later this week and the weekend.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center tropical weather outlook or advisory for the Gulf system on October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: A system in the Gulf has strengthened into a tropical depression, forecasters from the National Hurricane Center said on the afternoon of Oct. 6.
occurrences.speaker: National Hurricane Center
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center environmental analysis and forecast discussion for the Gulf system
occurrences.quote_span: In addition, disruptive wind shear is likely to be overcome by the system.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center forecast track and U.S. impact forecasts for the Gulf system
occurrences.quote_span: Direct impacts to the United States from the storm are still several days away.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center advisories for the Gulf system issued October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: The hurricane center said on the afternoon of Oct. 6 that "advisories (such as watches or warnings) will likely be issued on this system later today or tonight while it moves slowly eastward."
occurrences.speaker: National Hurricane Center
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: NOAA Atlantic hurricane season climatology
occurrences.quote_span: A typical season features seven hurricanes, according to NOAA.
occurrences.speaker: NOAA
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: Nicholas Arman's email to USA TODAY on October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: "The storm is already becoming better organized faster than expected, and the environment around it is becoming increasingly favorable for strengthening," said AccuWeather hurricane expert Nicholas Arman in an email to USA TODAY.
occurrences.speaker: Nicholas Arman
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center forecast discussion and impact forecast for the Gulf system
occurrences.quote_span: As the storm fully develops, the system could bring gusty winds and areas of heavy rain to the western portion of Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula, the hurricane center warned.
occurrences.speaker: National Hurricane Center
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: Matt Lanza's October 6, 2026 The Eyewall forecast
occurrences.quote_span: "The storm's potential ranges anywhere from a sloppy, disorganized system to a major hurricane," said meteorologist Matt Lanza in his Substack, The Eyewall.
occurrences.speaker: Matt Lanza
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: Alex DaSilva's AccuWeather online forecast and National Hurricane Center forecast track
occurrences.quote_span: "Due to prevailing steering winds, the most likely path would be to the north-northeast toward the U.S. later this week with landfall along the central Gulf Coast this weekend," AccuWeather hurricane expert Alex DaSilva said in an online forecast.
occurrences.speaker: Alex DaSilva
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: Alex DaSilva's AccuWeather forecast and National Hurricane Center forecast discussion
occurrences.quote_span: "As this storm organizes and begins to drift north-northeastward, increasing wind shear may limit the amount of strengthening and could lead to the storm becoming distorted," DaSilva said.
occurrences.speaker: Alex DaSilva
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Hurricane Center forecast track and meteorological forecast models for the Gulf system
occurrences.quote_span: At this time, meteorologists believe the storm is most likely to track near the panhandles of Mississippi, Alabama and Florida, as well as southeastern Louisiana.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: AccuWeather forecast probability for the Gulf system published October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Still, factoring in all the variables, AccuWeather meteorologists have raised the chance that the storm could become a hurricane to 45%.
occurrences.speaker: AccuWeather meteorologists
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression

occurrences.checkable_against: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration Gulf of Mexico sea-surface temperature observations
occurrences.quote_span: Factors favoring tropical development include warm Gulf water temperatures in the 80s, forecasters said.
occurrences.speaker: forecasters
occurrences.subject: Gulf tropical depression
